title: aes-128/aes-192/aes-256, 5 rounds: Five-round concrete differential feasibility [WJ19]

target.description: Five AES SubBytes layers with actual AES S-box and independent uniformly random round keys; first ShiftRows and final ShiftRows/MixColumns/AddRoundKey omitted by invertible difference-coordinate changes. The standard master-key schedule is not used.

setting.key_relation: An independently uniform round-key ensemble, not the distribution induced by the standard AES master-key schedule.
setting.key_population: Independent uniform round-key ensemble; averaging/existence quantifier is explicit in the property.
setting.plaintext_model: Source differential/linear patterns and their quantified propagation, not chosen-plaintext attack queries.
assumptions: An independently uniform round-key ensemble, not the distribution induced by the standard AES master-key schedule.

time.note: A structural statement, not an attack resource.

data.note: A structural statement, not an attack resource.

memory.note: A structural statement, not an attack resource.

preprocessing.note: A structural statement, not an attack resource.

success.description: A quantified structural property, not attack success.

evidence.locator: PDF p.3 / printed p.3003: models (1)-(3), independent-round-key contribution and fixed-key caveat; PDF p.6 / printed p.3006: five-round decomposition; PDF p.7 / printed p.3007, Theorem 3: principal five-round statement; PDF pp.8-14 / printed pp.3008-3014: supporting Lemmas 1-4 and Theorem 2 proof.
evidence.interpretation: All 18 PDF pages read independently. EDP nonzero symbols visually verified on PDF p.7. Theorem 3 is the five-round result; Theorem 2 on PDF pp.13-14 is the f1 subfunction lemma, not a separate full five-round theorem.

limitations: Round keys are sampled independently and uniformly; neither a per-fixed-key theorem nor a theorem for the standard AES master-key distribution.
The result establishes support positivity, not a quantitative probability bound, pseudorandomness, or an attack-resource lower bound.
Supporting finite AES S-box/counting checks and a reviewer expansion of Lemma 4 were performed; no complete 5-round/master-key exhaustive reproduction was attempted.

property.statement: Every nonzero concrete input/output differential of five-round AES has positive expected differential probability under independent uniform round keys.
property.quantifier: For every nonzero concrete input/output difference, the expected differential probability over independently uniform round keys is positive; not a statement for each fixed key or the real master-key distribution.
property.scope: The source 5-round AES SPN under independent uniform round keys, applicable to all three block-cipher instances only in this explicit changed-key model.

parameters.name: concrete_edp
parameters.meaning: Existential/ensemble feasibility, stronger than mere truncated-pattern feasibility.

validation.description: Complete primary read; supporting finite checks verify all nonzero AES S-box row/column support sizes, 65,025 inverse trace support identities, a tight Lemma 1 example, selected complete one/two-active-coordinate predecessor sets, and Lemma 4's abbreviated counting inequalities. These checks do not enumerate all five-round differentials.
